from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """One legal document: its title and stated cause of action (案由)."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as written")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The case cause of action (案由) stated in the document, e.g. '人格权纠纷', '合同纠纷', etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
